title: There Is No Antimemetics Division
author: qntm
summary: A hidden organisation fights threats that erase themselves from memory, so nobody can reliably remember them or even that they were fighting them. The book builds a strange, cerebral horror around that single idea.
readIf: you like clever concept-driven science fiction with a creeping, cosmic dread.
skipIf: you want strong character-driven drama or a conventional plot that holds together on a first skim.

pairings.reason: Both explore something that defies human understanding and slowly undermines the people investigating it.
Another work that plays with how stories and memory can be destabilised, though far more experimental in form.
Memory and reality come apart here too, in a faster and more emotional thriller.
